claims: The first documented first-person shooter was developed in 1973.
A customer who was at least 5 years old at the end of 1973 would have been born in or before 1968.
A person born in or before 1968 would have been at least 55 years old in 2023.
In 2023, customers with an active membership and an age of greater than 55 made a total of 3 action video game purchases.
